item.title: 16 Aug — SX Bet kills token; LaLiga kicks off
item.description: ## The one thing SX Bet’s SX token sunset window closed on August 15; eligible holders who didn’t accept the SX-token‑sunset/USDC‑credit terms by the cut‑off lose their credit rights. The venue says it’s migrating to a gasless architecture and moving users to USDC bet credits. That’s a real on‑chain product shift away from a native gas token toward simpler, fiat‑like UX.
